verdict.rationale: Inside the agent workflow, the skill produces AI-generated suggestions about the logo work: it recommends a concept, flags honest risks such as misreadings, and audits drafts against logo principles before showing them. These insights cover the skill's own generated concepts from the user's brief, not analysis of arbitrary user-supplied data. Missing for 10: insights drawn from user-provided data beyond the design brief, any documented analysis of the user's own existing assets or datasets, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: it shows the concepts as one overview image with a recommendation and offers the full kit
The skill flags its honest risk too: some people read the wedge as watermelon.
The audit caught a 60.8° diagonal in an early N and an off-centre symbol before anything was shown.
audit an SVG against logo principles
